newsitem.title: USA: Ambassador Apartments buys Florida property.
newsitem.headline: Ambassador Apartments buys Florida property.

text.p: Ambassador Apartments Inc said Tuesday it acquired its 50th property, the 420-unit Palencia Apartments in Tampa, Fla.

It said the property was acquired for $15 million and is encumbered by $13.3 million in tax exempt bonds issued by the Florida Housing Finance Authority. Ambassador said it now has eight properties in Florida.

The company also said it refinanced three existing properties. It said $6 million in tax exempt bonds were issued by the Industrial Development Authority of the City of Phoenix for the benefit of the 316-unit Crossroads Apartments.

In addition, Nomura Asset Capital Corp funded $21.5 million of 10-year, fixed-rate financing at an interest rate of 7.98 percent secured by the 288-unit Country Club West Apartments in Greeley and the 248-unit Courtney Park Apartments in Fort Collins, Colo.
